business_failure.root_cause: The grouped-year predicate correctly handled year-plus-change rows but rejected a legitimate leading table-unit cell before the annual years, so the period group label was not recombined.
business_failure.meaning: The values and annual role remained correct, but citation coordinates lost the source's explicit Year Ended May 31 boundary. Indexing that weaker lineage would make later audit and exact citation less reliable.
